# JNTUH Connect

> JNTUH Connect is an independent student utility for finding Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH) exam notifications, viewing academic results, and generating student-focused result summaries.

JNTUH Connect is not an official JNTUH website. Results and notifications should be verified against official university or college records when making academic decisions. Hall ticket numbers are 10-character student identifiers. Do not submit passwords, payment information, or unrelated personal data.

The site exposes supported result lookup forms as browser WebMCP tools. These tools retrieve or display information; they do not alter official university records or apply for grace marks.

## Main features

- [Home](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/): Entry point for result and student utilities.
- [Academic results](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/academicresult): View semester-by-semester results for one hall ticket number.
- [All academic results](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/academicallresult): View all available results for one hall ticket number.
- [Backlog report](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/backlogreport): Review current backlogs.
- [Credits checker](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/creditchecker): Review earned academic credits.
- [Result comparison](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/resultcontrast): Compare results for two hall ticket numbers.
- [Academic journey](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/journey): Generate an academic progress summary.
- [Exam notifications](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/notifications): Browse published JNTUH result notifications.

## Reference

- [Frequently asked questions](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/faq): Common questions and site guidance.
- [Privacy](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/privacy): Privacy information for the service.

## Optional

- [Academic calendars](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/calendars): Browse university academic calendars.
- [Syllabus](https://jntuhconnect.dhethi.com/syllabus): Browse available syllabus documents.
